items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The code is readable and matches the surrounding formatting. But the check `if getattr(queryset, "query", None) and queryset.query.is_sliced` raises ValueError reusing a message ("Cannot filter a query...") that hides the real constraint. That message is misleading at construction time.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The change works against the requested feature. It hard-codes a rejection in Prefetch.__init__ and documents the limitation instead of adding a shared helper to the related_descriptors get_prefetch_queryset paths. Supporting slicing later would mean undoing this guard, the doc note and the test.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: It validates input at the boundary and doesn't swallow errors. However, it turns a supported use case into an early error, and `getattr(queryset, "query", None)` relies on a truthiness check of the query object.

items.name: Per-parent slice semantics for open/bounded slices
items.name_zh: 开放/有界切片按父对象分区
items.evidence: No per-parent slicing is implemented. Prefetch now raises ValueError for any sliced queryset, so neither qs[n:] nor qs[n:m] works. Hidden tests failed: F2P 0/4 (all PrefetchLimitTests).
